messages.content: tumi ki manush ke shohoje forgive koro naki grudge rakho?
Sotti bolte depends - choto jinis shohoje forgive kori, kintu trust break howa jinis e shomoy lage. Grudge rakhi na exactly, but forget o kori na shohoje.
